title: Figure 26: Illustration of the retinal neuroprosthesis by the Boston Implant Project
description: Color illustration on a black background of a flexible implant circuit: a green signal-processing chip board on the left, a copper circular power induction coil on the right, and a thin stimulating microelectrode array projecting downward. Caption reads "Figure 26. An Illustration of the Retinal Neuroprosthesis Created by the Boston Implant Project" with a bostonretinalimplant.org URL. Accompanying text explains the coil and circuit layout and magnetic induction power.
